description: This file defines a React component named MCPServerPermissions that displays MCP servers and access groups, fetches server details and group names asynchronously, and allows toggling display of server-specific tool permissions.

methods.name: MCPServerPermissions
methods.description: React functional component that renders MCP server permissions with expandable tool details.

methods.name: getMCPServerDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a display name for MCP server using alias and truncated server ID.

methods.name: getAccessGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Returns display name for an access group (currently returns the group string itself).
